whyMenodao.title: Why Kenyans Choose MenoDAO
whyMenodao.subtitle: We're changing how dental care works in Kenya. No more waiting until you're in pain to see a dentist.
whyMenodao.card1Desc: Instead of paying KES 30,000 when you're in pain, you pay a little every month - like buying airtime. When you need care, it's already covered.
whyMenodao.card2Desc: Regular checkups mean we find small problems before they become big, expensive ones. You'll never lose a tooth unnecessarily.
whyMenodao.card3Desc: This isn't a big insurance company. It's a cooperative owned by members like you. You have a say in how things work.
whyMenodao.ctaSubtext: Takes less than 2 minutes to sign up

chamaRules.title: Chama Rules (Full Transparency)
chamaRules.subtitle: No hidden rules. No surprises. Here's exactly how MenoDAO operates.
chamaRules.emergencyDesc: Pain relief and urgent consultations covered
chamaRules.majorDesc: Fillings, root canals, and advanced care
chamaRules.zeroWaitDesc: Access emergency and major care from day 1
chamaRules.treasuryDesc: Your contributions are tracked in our records and available to members
chamaRules.auditedDesc: Every shilling is accounted for and subject to cooperative audit and member reporting
chamaRules.voiceDesc: Members help set priorities through cooperative processes
chamaRules.noFeesDesc: All costs are transparent and agreed upon
chamaRules.trustTitle: Built on Trust, Powered by Community
chamaRules.trustDesc: Every contribution and disbursement is recorded and tracked to ensure full accountability. Our system provides clear visibility into how funds are used.

technology.title: Your Data. Your Money. Secure.
technology.ledgerDesc: Every contribution and disbursement is recorded and tracked to ensure full accountability. Our system provides clear visibility into how funds are used.
technology.privacyDesc: Your medical records stay private between you and the doctor.
technology.paymentsDesc: Seamless integration with M-Pesa and licensed mobile money providers.

paymentsCompliance.title: Payments & Compliance
paymentsCompliance.body1: All payments on MenoDAO are processed in Kenyan Shillings (KES) through licensed mobile money providers.
paymentsCompliance.body2: MenoDAO does not process, support, or facilitate cryptocurrency or digital asset transactions.
paymentsCompliance.body3: We are committed to operating in full compliance with applicable financial regulations in Kenya.

about.title: Building Healthier Communities, One Smile at a Time
about.desc1: MenoDAO is a community-driven healthcare financing platform that helps individuals access affordable dental care by pooling contributions and facilitating transparent payments to verified clinics.
about.desc2: Founded on principles of transparency, affordability, and community ownership, we pool resources to make preventive and essential dental care accessible to all members.

howItWorks.title: How
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple path from contribution to dental care at trusted clinics.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Members make contributions using secure mobile payment options.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Funds are allocated to approved dental treatments based on verified needs.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Payments are made directly to partner clinics with full visibility for contributors.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.intro: MenoDAO operates as a healthcare support platform that facilitates contributions and payments for dental care services.
compliance.kes: All transactions are conducted in Kenyan Shillings (KES) through licensed mobile money providers.
compliance.noCrypto: MenoDAO does not engage in, support, or facilitate cryptocurrency or digital asset transactions.
compliance.commitment: We are committed to maintaining compliance with all applicable financial and regulatory requirements in Kenya.
